native_to_julia_mapping.reason: CUDA.jl matches original cuBLAStranspose API; portable targets use custom padded32x32 tile,32x8 lanes, edge guards.

keyconfounds: Puretranspose α1β0 only, not general GEAM matrix addition/op combinations. Both original FP32/FP64 precision modes covered at named1025x1537 shape; source16384²/other shapes unmeasured.
Native/CUDA.jl invoke cuBLAS S/Dgeam; KA/JACC use custom padded tile, so performance confounds vendor algorithm and framework. Vendor internal geometry/registers/shared policy unknown.
Study batches10 operations then synchronizes once pertrial for all4; original native synchronizes eachcall. Named protocol is not original fence-frequency measurement.
JACC stages1056-element zero template and adds initial barrier; KA local tile is written directly. Extra logical reads do not establish DRAM transactions.
FP32 input/output pair12.60MB andFP64 pair25.21MB exceed V1006MiB L2, but no profiler counters establish a bottleneck or DRAM roofline position.
No useful floating-point arithmetic is required by transpose; use logical read+write bandwidth, not invented GFLOP rates.

JACC starts with successful KA mapping; consumed usage includes cached context and coordination. Broad GEAM workflow includes a Gaussian fixture-generator packaging interruption outside both target phases.

scientific_intent.scientific_task: Rearrange dense matrix storage by transposing rows and columns without numerical arithmetic.
scientific_intent.mathematical_operation: out[col*nr+row]=input[row*nc+col], the α1β0 transpose special case of GEAM.
scientific_intent.discretization_or_topology: Row-major logical1025x1537 matrix, partial32x32 edge tiles; flat1575425 entries, tested separately Float32/Float64.
invariants: Output is exact permutation of all input entries.
Both last row and last column exercise partialtile edge guards.
accuracy_requirements: All1575425 Float32 orFloat64 outputs exact vs independent CPU index permutation and both references on5trials; finite checks.
scientific_intent.precision_sensitivity: No arithmetic roundoff is needed for tested transpose; FP64 increases bytes, not useful floatingpoint operations.
scientific_intent.input_size_regimes: 10 repeated out-of-place transposes pertrial with unchanged input, both precisions; named12.60/25.21MB totalinput/output footprints vs source16384² unmeasured.
scientific_intent.community_use_case: Matrix layout movement can support downstream dense linear algebra; source is synthetic puretranspose throughput and identifies no physical/scientific dataset.
scientific_intent.uncertainty: GEAM benchmark name does not imply general matrix addition or an application solver; no domain-level scientificaccuracy inferred.
